units.summary: Adds committedAppendID, returning lastAppendID when no appenders are open, else lowest open appendID minus 1, and 0 when isolation is disabled. It is used as the eviction watermark in compactHeadViewLocked. A too-high value could cause series eviction and sample loss. The ring layout (oldest at sentinel.next, new appends added at tail) matches the logic.
units.headline: Add committedAppendID computing highest guaranteed-committed append ID
units.reason: Concurrency-sensitive watermark that gates series eviction in head compaction; an off-by-one would silently lose samples.
focus: Confirm sentinel.next is the lowest open appendID (appenders are appended at the tail)
Off-by-one: lowest open minus 1 is conservative and correct
Disabled isolation returns 0, making the eviction append-ID check a no-op

units.summary: New table of subtests covering committedAppendID: disabled, no appenders, all closed, single and multiple open appenders, and open reads. They exercise the expected contract and add no production behavior.
